title: Torcy to the plenipotentiaries at Geertruidenberg (3 Apr 1710) and Villars to Polignac (1 Jun 1710), BL Add MS 61575

steps.what: Sought the ciphertext: Tomokiyo's files 404, DECODE images need login (thumbnail only), BL volume not digitised.
Fetched with the cookie the DECODE images of R8755 (7) and R8756 (2), the DOC transcriptions of both (Tomokiyo's, the files his dead links pointed to), and the neighbour records R8746-R8774.

Checked both DOC transcriptions against the images: Torcy agrees (notation 11^0=110 etc.; 729 confirmed by a repeat); Villars 575 -> 515 and a false gap. Transcribed the clear opening of Torcy's letter (f.38r-38v), which DECODE omits.
Prior-solution check: Tomokiyo's blencowe2.htm unchanged (both undeciphered), web search found no edition or decipherment.
Applied Tomokiyo's 11B table (Desmarets 4 June 1710 code, ~190 values) to both letters: nonsense; Villars' top group 340 absent.
Checked the Add MS 61575 keys: R8766 (Torcy-Petkum, DE=43/140; Torcy's letter has 43 once, 140 never), R8767 (one-part, DE=215 absent, English names), R8768 (1715-18 Jacobite names, DE=12).
Applied DECODE R587 (TNA SP 106/7 French two-part code, DECODE transcription) to Torcy: word salad of Northern names.
Screened BnF fr. 6204 War-ministry keys and the 1702 Usson code by their DE homophones (Tomokiyo); the Sixième clef is excluded by 'de de' (423 411) twice; the rest have 0-7 hits.

Legrelle iv 546 quotes the clear sentence and cites the letter in AE CP Hollande t. 223; Torcy's Journal inédit (30 Mar-3 Apr 1710) gives the context only; Villars' Mémoires iii do not print the 1 June letter to Polignac.
Torcy 690 groups, 285 types, IC 0.0042, two repeated trigrams: an 800+ value homophonic two-part code, too sparse for a ciphertext-only rebuild; Villars 173 groups too short.

outcome.method_basis: Both cipher parts unread: no key in Add MS 61575, on DECODE or in print fits either code; Torcy's 690 groups of an 800+ value two-part code and Villars' 173 groups are too few for a ciphertext-only rebuild. The French copy of Torcy's letter is in AE CP Hollande t. 223, not online.

gaps.detail: no key found; French copy in AE CP Hollande t. 223, not digitised
different code, no key found, too short for ciphertext-only

outcome.notes: Clear opening of Torcy's letter transcribed (DECODE omits it). R8756 metadata has sender/receiver reversed.

prior.where: The French file copy of Torcy's letter, AE CP Hollande t. 223 (cited by Legrelle iv 546 n.2); nothing printed; Tomokiyo (blencowe2.htm, 2024) lists both as undeciphered

human: Selected the target; supplied the DECODE login cookie.
